name: Spot On Chain
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The X account of the crypto data tracking service Spot On Chain has reportedly been compromised. It was said to have posted a fake EIGEN airdrop phishing link this morning, while also disabling the comment section for the tweet. Users are advised to be cautious and avoid interacting with the link.
